_comment: Parish photo provenance registry. Every entry MUST carry rights (permission_granted | public_domain | open_license | own_work | pending_permission) and a rightsNote tracing the holder and evidence. Only cleared rights render (lib/photos.ts); pending entries are the paper trail of what returns when permission lands. Guard: scripts/verify-photo-rights.mjs.
